name: @ocw/browser-engine
description: The shared browser engine of the bots' brw image and the Work Zone Local Runtime (07.13, D-04): the redacting snapshot serializer, the isolated world, screencast and masked screenshots, safe zip extraction and the P-09 site filter of storage states. Plain ESM with hand-written types; playwright-core is a peer (capture and unzip load its bundled PNG, JPEG and zip readers).
